title: API: parts list with search NOT padded by spaces returns untracked active parts plus normal matches on not
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 (untracked, active). Setup as (a): a tracked part "QA-S6-NOT-{run}" with description "QA notch filter" (contains "not"). Setup as (a): New Inventory Part, Description "QA S6 inactive untracked", Part Number "QA-S6-INU-{run}", Category, Cost, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off, Save; reopen it, pick Part Status Inactive (radio_part_status_inactive), Save, then Deactivate in "Deactivate part?" (toast "Part deactivated.").
custom_steps:
1. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active (no search) and load every page the way the screen does; note the ids of the rows with is_tracked false.
  2. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=%20NOT%20 and load every page.
  3. Compare the step 2 rows with the step 1 untracked ids and with the tracked rows.
  4. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=not.
  5. Look for QA-S6-INU-{run} in the step 2 result.
custom_expected:
1. 200; the untracked active ids include QAPL-U1 and QAPL-U2.
  2. 200; the rows include QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 and QA-S6-NOT-{run}.
  3. The set equals every untracked active id from step 1 plus the active tracked parts whose number, description or tags contain "not" (QA-S6-NOT-{run} included); no other tracked part.
  4. 200 with the same set as step 2 (case and outer spaces do not matter).
  5. Not present: every row has is_active true, so no inactive part (even an untracked one) is returned with status=active.
